entries.description: Project quota is armed again on a box whose initramfs dracut builds (Ubuntu 26.04 cloud images): the one-shot that sets the ext4 features went in as an initramfs-tools hook, which dracut never reads, so quota stayed pending. It now goes in as a dracut module. Quota turns on at the next reboot, which this update does not do

The templates an operator chooses and edits move to /etc/hestia/templates: an update overwrote every shipped one under /usr/local/hestia/templates, and the both model could not offer a template of its own. A file still as shipped is replaced by the current copy, an edited or own one moves as it is, an edited default or panel becomes an override; files without a place any more (docker, apache) land in /etc/hestia/templates/unplaced/. The update output names each file it kept
